description: This file implements the core functionality of the Locally Optimal Block Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (LOBPCG) method for eigenvalue problems, including autograd support, auxiliary functions for polynomial computations, and a worker class for iterative optimization.

classes.name: LOBPCGAutogradFunction
classes.description: Custom autograd function to support backward propagation for the LOBPCG method.

classes.name: LOBPCG
classes.description: Worker class managing the iterative process of the LOBPCG algorithm, including updates, convergence checks, and iteration control.

methods.name: _symeig_backward_complete_eigenspace(D_grad, U_grad, A, D, U)
methods.description: Computes the gradient contribution when the eigenspace is complete, involving eigenvalue derivatives and eigenspaces.

methods.name: _polynomial_coefficients_given_roots(roots)
methods.description: Given roots of a polynomial, computes the polynomial's coefficients using Vieta's formula.

methods.name: _polynomial_value(poly, x, zero_power, transition)
methods.description: Evaluates a polynomial at a given point using Horner's rule with a custom transition function.

methods.name: _matrix_polynomial_value(poly, x, zero_power=None)
methods.description: Evaluates a matrix polynomial at a matrix argument via Horner's rule.

methods.name: _vector_polynomial_value(poly, x, zero_power=None)
methods.description: Evaluates a vector polynomial at a vector argument via Horner's rule.

methods.name: _symeig_backward_partial_eigenspace(D_grad, U_grad, A, D, U, largest)
methods.description: Computes the gradient contribution for partial eigenspaces, involving projections and polynomial functions of matrices.
